declarations.name: reduces
declarations.statement:
theorem reduces n! to one when the prime modulus is n+2. -/
theorem factorial_eq_one_mod_prime_offset (n : ℕ) (hp : (n + 2).Prime) :
    (n.factorial : ZMod (n + 2)) = 1

declarations.name: solution_prime_offset_residues
declarations.statement:
theorem solution_prime_offset_residues (n m : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hp : (n + 2).Prime) (hsol : n.factorial + 1 = m ^ 2) :
    (n + 2) % 8 = 1 ∨ (n + 2) % 8 = 7

declarations.name: prime_offset_two_obstruction
declarations.statement:
theorem prime_offset_two_obstruction (n : ℕ) (hp : (n + 2).Prime)
    (hbad : (n + 2) % 8 = 3 ∨ (n + 2) % 8 = 5) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, n.factorial + 1 ≠ m ^ 2

declarations.name: reject_eleven
declarations.statement: theorem reject_eleven : ∀ m : ℕ, Nat.factorial 11 + 1 ≠ m ^ 2
